claim: To use Aurora for disaster recovery of a MySQL DB instance, create an Amazon Aurora DB cluster and make it a read replica of the MySQL DB instance.
question: How can Aurora be used as an offsite disaster recovery copy of a MySQL DB instance?

values.display: make it a read replica of your MySQL DB instance
disaster recovery of your MySQL DB instance

evidence.quote: To use Aurora for disaster recovery of your MySQL DB instance, create an Amazon Aurora DB cluster and make it a read replica of your MySQL DB instance.
This applies to an RDS for MySQL DB instance, or a MySQL database running external to Amazon RDS.
